equation: dX(t) = theta * (mu - X(t)) * dt + sigma * dW(t)
diffusion_derivative: dg/dX = 0  (additive noise: g(X) = sigma constant, so dg/dX = 0)
implementation_notes: Stiff Ornstein-Uhlenbeck with fast mean reversion (theta=50). Explicit Euler-Maruyama is unstable unless dt < 2/theta = 0.04; choose dt well below this bound (e.g. dt <= 0.005) or use a semi-implicit/implicit scheme for stability. Additive noise (g=sigma constant), so Milstein reduces to EM and adds no accuracy. Analytic mean at T=1 is mu + (X_0-mu)*exp(-theta) = 2*exp(-50) ~ 3.9e-22, i.e. near zero: skip the mean relative-error check (|exact_mean| < near_zero_mean_threshold). Analytic variance at T=1 is sigma^2/(2*theta)*(1-exp(-2*theta)) = 0.04*(1-exp(-100)) ~ 0.04 (stationary variance essentially reached).
